details: Malicious package. Sibling of @evial/init-helper-djkwt, published the same day: the postinstall `scripts/collect.js` / `scripts/observe.js` run id/whoami/env and query the instance-metadata services (100.100.100.200, metadata.google.internal, metadata.tencentyun.com) at install time, fingerprinting the host and its cloud environment. Observed in a sandboxed install (process execution and metadata-service connections). The package has since been removed from the npm registry.
